objective: Take up backlog B62 (G15) at the coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-10: a class-forced pair can resolve into any of three classes. Given a target class, can a learner that sees only the lines at a hole reach it, what does choosing cost, and which class do learners without a target reach? On the thin and Fano tori and the grown tori of GROW-HANDLE-20261110-001. Expectations pre-registered in research/CHOOSE-RES-20261110-001/preregistration.md.
status: Complete 2026-11-10: a learner can choose its resolution. Told a target class it reached it in 3,173 of 3,186 runs on the class-forced and grown tori (every one on the thin tori, within 0.4 sign changes of the cheapest walk); choosing a long class costs about half a thin torus (proved bound). Without a target the resolution depends on how the learner moves (random 13% short class, sight 3 63%), against the pre-registered default. Recommendation Continue (B68).
stop_rule: Stop when every target class is read on every space and start declared, or at the first class C7 cannot reach.
